question: When was the Jan Dhan Yojana launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2014**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jan Dhan Yojana:**

 
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)** was launched on **28 August 2014** by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.
 
• It is a **national mission for financial inclusion** aimed at providing affordable financial services to all households in India.
 
• The scheme focuses on ensuring access to banking, savings, credit, insurance, and pension facilities for the unbanked population.
 
• It is one of the largest financial inclusion initiatives in the world.
 
• **Objectives of Jan Dhan Yojana:**
 
• To provide **universal access to banking facilities** for all households.
 
• To offer **basic savings bank accounts** with a RuPay debit card and overdraft facility.
 
• To promote **financial literacy** and awareness among citizens.
 
• To provide **accident insurance cover** of Rs. 2 lakh and **life insurance cover** of Rs. 30,000 to account holders.
 
• To ensure access to **credit, insurance, and pension** services for the economically weaker sections.
 
 
 
• ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
 
 
• **Zero-balance accounts** with no minimum balance requirement.
 
• **RuPay debit card** with inbuilt accident insurance cover.
 
• **Overdraft facility** of up to Rs. 10,000 for eligible account holders.
 
• **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** of government subsidies and welfare schemes.
 
• **Mobile banking** and **missed call banking** facilities for easy access.
